 Here are the Predictions for Nepal Premier League 2026, 12th Match - Biratnagar Kings vs Janakpur Bolts and 13th Match - Lumbini Lions vs Pokhara Avengers, to be played on the 3rd of November at the Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur.
 Match Prediction - Biratnagar Kings v Janakpur Bolts 
 LIVE SCORES - 12th Match - Biratnagar Kings vs Janakpur Bolts (Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur) 
 Ground Stat: 
 Average 1st Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 157
 Average 2nd Innings Total at Tribhuvan University International Cricket Ground, Kirtipur (Nepal Premier League) - 137
 Current Form Janakpur Bolts: 
 Janakpur Bolts are currently placed at the 2nd position on points table with 2 wins and 1 loss to their credit. They have 4 points to their name.
 The top run scorer for Janakpur Bolts in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Moeen Ali with 98 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Janakpur Bolts in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Harmeet Singh with 6 scalps under his belt .
 Janakpur Bolts have won their previous match against Pokhara Avengers by 9 runs.
 Janakpur Bolts batted first and they posted a total of 147 for 7 in 20 overs. Moeen Ali and Trit Raj Das once again gave a thrilling start to Janakpur Bolts. They collected 47 runs for the 1st wicket partnership. Ali made 21 while Trit Raj Das went on to score 61 runs off 55 deliveries. The middle order struggled to infuse any momentum into the innings though. It was Abhisekh Tiwari, who smashed 24 runs in only 10 deliveries to help Janakpur Bolts get to 147 in 20 overs of play.
 During the chase, Pokhara Avengers lost the key wickets of Mahedi Hasan and Dinesh Kharel quite early. After their dismissals, Kushal Bhurtel tried his best to revive the innings. He made 35 quick runs but was dismissed at a wrong time by Lalit Rajbanshi. After his dismissal, the Janakpur Bolts bowlers were all over Pokhara Avengers. Wickets kept falling in regular succession and Pokhara Avengers never really looked stable. Moeen Ali bowled beautifully. He picked up 3 wickets for 13 runs in his spell to help restrict Pokhara Avengers out to 138 for 9 in 20 overs, as they lost the game by 9 runs.
 Current Form Biratnagar Kings: 
 Biratnagar Kings are currently placed at the 5th position on points table with 1 win and 2 losses to their credit. They have 2 points to their name.
 The top run scorer for Biratnagar Kings in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Lokesh Bam with 138 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Biratnagar Kings in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Angelo Mathews with 5 scalps under his belt .
 Biratnagar Kings have won their previous match against Sudurpaschim Royals by 35 runs.
 The match was reduced to 5 overs per side due to rain.
 Biratnagar Kings batted first and they posted a highly competitive total of 105 in 5 overs of play. Shehan Jayasuriya and Lokesh Bam started off very well for Biratnagar Kings. Jayasuriya made 39 off 11 balls, collecting 2 fours and 5 sixes. Lokesh Bam and Andre Russell were also quite destructive with the bat. Bam made 25 while Russell scored 29 runs in only 10 balls as Biratnagar Kings managed to get to 105 in 5 overs of play.
 During the chase, Sudurpaschim Royals lost their way right from the word go. They lost the key wickets of Sherfane Rutherford and Dipendra Singh Airee quite early. After their dismissals, Saif Zaib and Aarif Sheikh tried to revive the innings but both of them got out at a wrong time. Sudurpaschim Royals couldn't really stage a comeback after that and they were eventually restricted to 70 for 3 in 5 overs, losing the match by a big margin of 35 runs.

 Current Form Lumbini Lions: 
 Lumbini Lions are currently placed at the 3rd position on points table with 1 win and 1 No Result Match to their credit. They have 3 points to their name.
 The top run scorer for Lumbini Lions in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is D'Arcy Short with 40 runs to his name.
 The top wicket taker for Lumbini Lions in the Nepal Premier League 2026 is Kishore Mahato with 4 scalps under his belt .
 The previous match of Lumbini Lions against Chitwan Rhinos was cancelled due to rain. However, in their last outing, Lumbini Lions won against Sudurpaschim Royals by 7 wickets.
 Sudurpaschim Royals batted first and they posted a total of 87 before being bowled out. Saif Zaib, Binod Bhandari and Aarif Sheikh all got out cheaply and Sudurpaschim Royals got off to the most horrible start. Brandon McMullen also got out cheaply. Dipendra Singh Airee tried to revive the innings with a knock of 27 runs but he kept losing partners in regular succession. Sudurpaschim Royals could never gain momentum into the innings and they were eventually bowled out for just 87.
 During the chase, Lumbini Lions started off very well. Openers D'Arcy Short and Aasif Sheikh were really calculative in their shot selection. Short made 40 runs off 18 balls while Sheikh scored 32 runs in 25 deliveries to seal the deal in favor of Lumbini Lions. They chased the target quite comfortably in the 10th over itself with 7 wickets in hand.
